quantity: ideal shear strength of Si and diamond on (111)[11-2] (twinning sense)
code: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x 7.5 (conda-forge qe-7.5-hc91ee90_1) through ASE
labelling: computed with DFT-PBE in this project: a model value (PBE), never a measurement

Si.description: (111)[11-2], twinning (easy) sense: upper block displaced along +[11-2]
Si.value_source: maximum of the samples recomputed on the k-refined mesh [14, 14, 14]

k_refined.note: cells (T) and starting ions of the production path; ions re-relaxed on the denser mesh; the lateral stresses were not re-iterated (their change moves sigma_xz by ~0.05 GPa)

Si.max_lateral_residual_note: production-mesh path only (the lateral stresses were iterated there; samples past an instability included)
Si.k_refined_lateral_note: the k-refined samples reuse the production cells and were not re-relaxed laterally; with the stage-1 Cij the linear-elastic coupling of a lateral residual r to sigma_xz is at most 0.26 r, i.e. <= 0.2 GPa here (an estimate: tangent moduli at large strain differ)

literature.functional: LDA (Perdew-Zunger cited; not stated in the abstract)
literature.confidence: high for the value, medium for the functional
literature.source: Roundy and Cohen 2001, abstract ((111)[11-2], relaxed; sense not stated)
Y. Umeno, J. Solid Mech. Mater. Eng. 2, 1360 (2008), Table 2 ({111}<11-2>, weakest system; as read for data/hardness_calibration/materials.json)

records.name: ideal_shear_strength

orientation.description: (111)[11-2], twinning (easy) sense: upper block displaced along +[11-2]

conditions.stress_state: simple shear on (111) with the other five Cauchy stress components relaxed to zero, 0 K

method.name: DFT ideal shear strength: affine simple shear, ions and lateral stresses relaxed
method.description: pw.x, PBE, SSSP_1.3.0_PBE_efficiency, ecutwfc 40 Ry / ecutrho 320 Ry, k-mesh (10, 10, 10) offset (0, 0, 0), gaussian smearing 0.01 Ry, conv_thr 1e-11 Ry/atom; 2-atom primitive cell in the lab frame (x = shear direction, z = [111]); T_xz controlled, the other five T components iterated to |sigma| <= 0.25 GPa; strength = maximum of sigma_xz (parabolic refinement) at engineering strain 0.287
assumptions: 0 K static lattice (no zero-point or thermal effects)
homogeneous deformation of the 2-atom cell: phonon (non-affine) instabilities are not tested, so the value is an upper bound of the ideal strength
lattice parameter and Cij from stage 1 with the same settings

uncertainty.description: k+8 vs k+4 at the refined peak
